_comment: Figures that look alike across modules but measure different things. Each note names every place the figures appear, what each one measures and why they are never added or compared. Rendered on the methodology page and beside the figures (hub.js → HUB.scope). Add a note whenever the same company or deal appears with a different basis or scope in two modules.

notes.title_es: Arrendamientos: no iniciados (sin descontar) frente a reconocidos (valor presente y sin descontar)
notes.title_en: Leases: not yet commenced (undiscounted) versus recognized (present value and undiscounted)

figures.es: arrendamientos firmados aún no iniciados: pagos futuros sin descontar (nota de arrendamientos)
figures.en: leases signed, not yet commenced: future payments, undiscounted (lease note)

figures.es: pasivos por arrendamiento reconocidos: valor presente (balance)
figures.en: recognized lease liabilities: present value (balance sheet)

figures.es: pagos de los arrendamientos reconocidos sin descontar: total de la tabla de vencimientos, antes de restar el interés implícito
figures.en: payments of the recognized leases, undiscounted: maturity-table total, before subtracting imputed interest

notes.why_es: Solo se compara lo firmado con los pagos reconocidos sin descontar (misma base). Compararlo con el pasivo a valor presente exagera la diferencia por construcción.
notes.why_en: What is signed is compared only with the undiscounted payments of recognized leases (same basis). Comparing it with the present-value liability overstates the gap by construction.
